steps.label: 1632-lab-math-ink-recognize-submit
command: (() => {const d=window.MathFieldDialog.get(),b=d.backdrop.querySelector('[data-ink=recognize]');if(d.tab!=='ink'||d.ink.isEmpty||b.disabled)throw Error('Expected nonempty handwriting ready for OCR');b.click();return {action:'Submit drawn single stroke via actual Recognize button once',endpointPath:'/api/math-ocr',strokeCount:d.ink.strokes.length};})()
